messages.subject: For Abhijit Dubey | AI infrastructure, government relations and global stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Bosio,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Abhijit Dubey, President, Chief Executive Officer and Chief AI Officer of NTT DATA, Inc.

NTT DATA's global AI, cloud and digital-infrastructure platform operates across public-sector, regulated and emerging-market environments where government relationships and stakeholder trust are increasingly important. That intersection closely matches my experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate complex cross-functional matters across regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, global stakeholder strategy and emerging-market execution might support NTT DATA's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to NTT DATA.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
